notes: Two isnads to Safwan, each written in full: two groups, null tail (rule 4).
«عن عمّه محمّد بن أبي القاسم»: «عمه» with a name is one link (rule 7).
«أبيه» and «أبي» have no name in the text; they are relations to the compiler's line and are not completed.
The opening «ما كان فيه عن صفوان بن مهران» is the report's topic, not a link.
